component.name: Doki
component.summary: Hand your game saves between devices

description.p: Doki keeps a history of your emulator saves and hands them between your devices. Another device's save never replaces yours on its own: it waits in Incoming until you choose to use it, keep it alongside, or keep yours.
Checkpoints happen on their own while Doki runs, in a window or in the tray, and every replacement first makes a verified backup.
